AI never forgets what you told it.","id":"gh:1335494886","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-recall","slug":"Relistencode/dsh-recall","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","memory","recall","semantic-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Conversation history recall for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — literal/fuzzy/semantic retrieval of every p"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ast conversation, fully local & offline. AI never forgets what you told it."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-recall"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"🌏 中文 · English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Conversation history recall plugin — a "memory maze" for your DeepSeek Harness agent**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"["},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **AI never forgets what you told it.**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"A native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that gives the agent a **memory maze** — corridors and rooms "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"built from every conversation you have had together. Every decision, setting, discussion, or casuall"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"y mentioned requirement is remembered. Ask "where were we?" and it walks the maze, brings back the c"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"onversation **verbatim**, and answers as naturally as if it had never forgotten — you won't even not"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ice it thought for a moment."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Conversation history recall · Three-layer retrieval (literal / fuzzy / semantic) · Fully local & off"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"line · Compaction-proof"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- While searching, a quiet sweeping light appears in the corner:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- When done, no trace:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Who is it for"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Heavy users of long sessions** — conversations spanning days and hundreds of turns, too long to "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"scroll back through
- **Writers / RP / tavern players** — settings, foreshadowing, and character rel"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ationships scattered across months of chat
- **Code & doc maintainers** — the reasoning behind past "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"decisions and pitfalls, now reduced to a one-line summary
- **Anyone who has said "didn't we discuss"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" this before?"** — it brings back the original words instead of making you retell them"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Conversely, if your sessions are short and easy to scroll, you probably don't need it — it is built "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"for "history too long, memory compacted" scenarios."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"One command: the package ships its own composition patch (bundle layer), so the plugin and the searc"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"h index it needs are wired up automatically. Restart `dsh web`. Nothing else to do — the model ships"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" with the package (~37MB full install), the index builds on first search, and semantic warm-up finis"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"hes quietly in the background (a few minutes, imperceptible to you)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> You can also install / disable / uninstall dsh-recall from the **Add-ons** block of the Plugin Man"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"agement tab in dsh-extension-hub."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Install from source (git clone):**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The repository tracks the model (`models/model_merged.onnx`) and the vendored runtime, so a git inst"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"all is fully functional offline with no build step and no `allowBuilds` entry. The optional `dsh-rec"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"all-models` dependency is still attempted from npm; if it fails to resolve, the in-repo model is use"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"d instead — either way the semantic layer works. The harness resolves all paths through `$DSH_HOME` "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"(default `~/.dsh`), so this works identically regardless of where your harness home lives."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## What it is not"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- ❌ **Not context engineering** — it does not cram history into the model window
- ❌ **Not prompt en"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"gineering** — it does not rely on prompts to make the model "pretend to remember"
- ❌ **Not a memory"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"-document system** — no MEMORY.md or manual notes to maintain
- ✅ It is **actual recall**: on-demand"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" retrieval of the **original records** — including history **already compacted away** (compaction on"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ly summarizes; the original text stays searchable forever)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Capability overview"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Capability | Implementation |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Three-layer hybrid retrieval | Literal / fuzzy / semantic merged automatically with a coverage gat"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e (≥90%) and a silent degradation chain |
| Progressive disclosure | Light coarse recall by default "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"(titles + snippets + events, ~100–800 tokens); `detail` drills into the original text — hit list / e"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"xact window / paged browsing |
| Event aggregation | Repeated mentions of one topic merge into event"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"s (`[startSeq..endSeq]`, ≤5 text blocks apart) — one complete episode instead of scattered fragments"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"; the full event text is one `detail` browse away |
| Proactive recall | The agent recalls on its ow"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"n when needed (after compaction, when details are missing); explicit user requests also work |
| Com"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"paction anchor | On `compaction/summary`, one lightweight anchor is injected automatically (summary "},{"id":"p25s9","text":"+ key original fragments, expires after 3 turns) |
| Scope control | Current session only by default"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"; `workspace` / `all` only on explicit user request |
| Compaction-proof | Index covers the full his"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"tory, including shadowed (compacted) events |
| Incremental indexing | Live sessions via `ctx.sessio"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"ns`, persisted via `sessionPersistence`, append-only deltas |
| Background warm-up | Worker-thread e"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"mbedding (~10 texts/sec), host event loop never blocked |
| Invisible UI | "Recalling…" sweep → one "},{"id":"p25s14","text":"quiet "Recall complete" line; results never enter the UI, the agent presents them naturally |
| Full"},{"id":"p25s15","text":"y local & offline | Zero npm runtime dependencies; no external model APIs; works with no network at "},{"id":"p25s16","text":"al & offline | Zero npm runtime dependencies; no external model APIs; works with no network at all |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Turn lifecycle (top)**: one recall is a straight line — the user asks, the agent calls the `reca"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ll` tool, the three layers are searched, hits are grouped into events per session, and the agent rec"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"eives either a light coarse recall or a drill-down window, depending on what it needs.
- **Retrieval"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" layer**: three independent retrieval channels (literal / fuzzy / semantic) that merge under a cover"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"age gate (see Three-layer hybrid retrieval).
- **Index & data**: everything is read through official"},{"id":"p27s6","text":" services (`ctx.sessions` / `ctx.sessionPersistence` / `ctx.sessionQuery`) — no `.zstd` parsing, no "},{"id":"p27s7","text":"private formats. The plugin's own `recall-index.db` (SQLite) holds the fuzzy index, the vectors and "},{"id":"p27s8","text":"the trigram FTS.
- **Governance & scope**: the scope red line (session by default), the coverage gat"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"e, the degradation chain, and the token budget live here.
- **Automatic layer**: a `compaction/summa"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"ry` listener that turns every compaction into one lightweight anchor, so the agent keeps its bearing"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"s after history is folded away."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Scope & privacy"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Default scope is the **current session only** — cross-session (`workspace`) and cross-project (`al"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"l`) searches happen only on the user's explicit request.
- The reply layer is invisible: a quiet "Re"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"calling…" sweep, one "Recall complete" line, nothing else. Results never enter the UI — the agent pr"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"esents them naturally.
- Data stays on this machine: no external APIs, no telemetry, no network."}],"truncated":true}
